Associazione Calcio Reggiana 1919, commonly referred to as Reggiana, is a professional football club based in Reggio Emilia, Emilia-Romagna, Italy. The club was formed in 1919, reformed in 2005 and 2018 after going bankrupt twice, and currently plays in the Serie C, the third tier of Italian football. Reggiana is known as i Granata in reference to the club's main colour: maroon.
